transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Cellular technical queue, agent 401.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello, my name is Oscar Lindqvist. My mobile phone data has been throttled down to fifty kilobits per second for three days: web pages time out, Google Maps won't load, and WhatsApp messages take two minutes to send, even though my S-Net account app confirms I have fifteen gigabytes of high-speed data remaining on my monthly allowance!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can inspect the data bearer profile on the cellular line. What mobile telephone number is experiencing the bandwidth throttle?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is 07700 900741, registered to 34 Crown Street, Aberdeen, AB11 6HJ, security PIN 5510.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that brings up the cellular record. What specific error message displays when you attempt to browse websites?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Safari says 'Server connection timed out', and speed tests report 0.05 Mbps download and zero upload!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query the mobile network traffic management console?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding. The core cellular gateway indicates that a fair usage policy bandwidth throttle flag is active on the subscriber IMSI.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why is a fair usage throttle active when I only used fifteen gigabytes of my thirty-gigabyte plan?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Automated traffic management algorithms throttle lines when sudden high-bandwidth video tethering spikes occur during peak evening hours.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I used tethering to watch a football match on my laptop while visiting my brother! That is completely within my paid data allowance!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you use your mobile handset as a substitute home broadband pipe for video streaming, you trigger automated traffic management throttling.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Your advertising explicitly says tethering is included in our data plans! Why are you penalizing me for using my allowance?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Tethering is subject to fair usage network management policies enforced during cell tower congestion.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you lift the throttle flag right now so I can use the fifteen gigabytes I paid for?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Fair usage flags are governed by centralized policy controllers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello? Is anyone there? The phone went completely dead for half a minute!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I was querying the Scottish regional cell tower congestion index.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will you remove the throttle flag today or not?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously mobile networks must throttle heavy data users to protect shared radio spectrum for general subscribers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am not a heavy user! I used fifteen gigabytes in an entire month!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am a long-haul lorry driver stranded at a remote truck stop near Inverness in the freezing cold! My cab heating timer and delivery dispatch app both require mobile data, and your 2G throttle has frozen my tablet! I cannot download my tomorrow delivery manifest, I cannot turn on my diesel heater remotely, and I am freezing in my lorry! I am furious and terrified!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand how terrifying and freezing cold that situation is in your lorry cab near Inverness, and how vital your delivery manifest and heating controls are tonight. Being stranded in freezing weather without data access is an emergency, so let us inspect the policy throttle immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you clear the throttle flag right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Frontline telephony representatives do not have administrative override permissions for core traffic management flags.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Then transfer me to your network operations manager who can override it!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Network operations engineers do not accept transferred customer telephone calls.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So what is an emergency stranded lorry driver supposed to do tonight?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The fair usage policy throttle resets automatically at midnight on your monthly billing cycle date.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: When is my billing cycle date?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your next monthly billing cycle date is in eleven days on October 28th.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Eleven days?! You expect a lorry driver to freeze in Scotland with 50 Kbps data for eleven days?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Those are the automated constraints of the traffic policy algorithm.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This is utterly heartless. Can I purchase a one-off high-speed data booster to override the throttle?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Data bolt-on boosters cannot override an active fair usage throttle profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you log an emergency technical escalation with your duty manager?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can submit an emergency duty manager review form.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello? Are you still on the line? Why does your headset keep cutting out into total silence?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have submitted the duty manager review form under ticket reference MOB-FAIR-88192-A.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: MOB-FAIR-88192-A, noted down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Duty managers review escalation forms within twenty-four to forty-eight hours.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Forty-eight hours does not heat my lorry tonight.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before I close this escalation file, what was that mobile telephone number again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Like I said earlier, it is 07700 900741.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have documented your mobile number on the duty manager ticket.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So my mobile data remains throttled at 50 Kbps tonight.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The throttle will remain active pending duty manager policy evaluation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will have to walk in the dark to the truck stop diner to borrow their Wi-Fi for my heater app. Unbelievable.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is an alternative connectivity option.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You have been completely useless.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other cellular issue I can assist with today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
